description: A large city plaza is shown at dusk. The ground rumbles and buildings around begin to shift. Pieces of a giant sneaker start rising from underground, assembling piece by piece in front of a mirrored skyscraper. Once fully formed, lights streak across its sides, finishing with the brand logo beaming above.
camera: wide-angle flyover, dynamic orbit, slow push-in on final form
lighting: cool sunset tones with neon reflections
atmosphere: urban ambient, light wind, subtle rumble
elements: giant sneaker parts rising with mechanical sounds
skyscraper lights syncing with product shape
motion: sneaker parts rise from ground and lock together, building lights pulse in sync
cta_motion: brand logo beams from the top of the final product like a hologram
ending: fully assembled sneaker towering above the plaza, glowing and reflecting city lights
